description.en: Windows desktop control connector: screen capture (including occluded and off-screen windows), window listing and focus, mouse move, click, drag and scroll, key presses and arbitrary text input, exposing 10 tools through koffi FFI.
description.zh: Windows 桌面控制连接器：截屏（含被遮挡与半出屏窗口）、枚举与置顶窗口、鼠标移动、点击、拖拽与滚轮、发送按键与输入任意文字，通过 koffi FFI 提供 10 个工具。
